info.description:
Derwent APIs provide seamless access to enriched patent data, enabling users to enhance their research capabilities and make faster, more informed decisions.

With user-friendly API endpoints, users can easily integrate reliable patent data into their existing systems, saving time and resources and streamline patent and innovation workflows.

Access a vast database of global patent information, including titles and abstracts for 65m+ inventions, optimized assignee data, and corrected priority data errors for more reliable insights.

Patent and family status, dead (D) or alive (A) quickly shows you whether a patent or patent family is currently enforceable. Patent status uses a machine-learning algorithm to examine crucial patent data to determine the vitality status of a single patent or a patent family. DSI_INVENTION_GLOBALIZATION_SCORE.description:

DSI_INVENTION_INFLUENCE_SCORE.description:
Influence or citation score. The downstream influence on other innovators of each patented idea, compiled by patent examiners, and normalized for variation by technology sector and differences that occur by geography or language. Every combination of technical theme and geography has an expected level of patent citation over time, and we assess individual inventions in comparison to that influence curve.
This field will be normalized to number [0-100].

DWPI_ACCESSION_NUMBER.description:
The DWPI Primary Accession number (also known as PAN) is a unique identifier for the whole DWPI family representing a single invention. The first four digits represent the year the record was created. DWPI has a strict family definition in which each member shares exact priorities (except for non-convention equivalents) with each and every other family member. INPADOC, in contrast, has a very broad family definition that includes divisions, continuations and continuations in part. All that is needed is a shared priority of any one member to another.

Subject specialists consistently apply these unique classification systems to the DWPI patent documents. DWPI Class is a broad, simple system, whereas DWPI Manual Codes are more detailed and granular. Both DWPI Class and DWPI Manual Codes cover all technologies within 20 subject areas, identified by Section letters A-X which are grouped into three broad categories for Chemistry, Engineering and Electronics.
